text: {"name":"ble_connection_state_handle","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Dispatches controller states 9 and 10, posting connection metadata and updating the per-link profile for state 9 or notifying controller readiness for state 10.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"v1":"connection_record","v2":"link_context","v3":"profile_index","v4":"message","v5":"profile_entry","v6":"profile_state"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":52,"meaning":"The connection record's 16-bit value is byte-swapped into the profile entry; the profile entry's byte at this offset stores the derived state."},{"offset":56,"meaning":"The connection record's 16-bit field is copied into a message; the profile entry's 16-bit field at this offset receives the byte-swapped value."},{"offset":58,"meaning":"8-bit connection field copied into the outgoing message."},{"offset":61,"meaning":"Connection index used to select a link context and copied into outgoing messages."},{"offset":116,"meaning":"Link-context field used as an index into the profile-entry table."},{"offset":1208,"meaning":"Low bit selects the derived profile state."}]}
